41797-the-story-book-girls.title: The Story Book Girls
41797-the-story-book-girls.creator: Unknown
41797-the-story-book-girls.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In a pink and white bedroom where two beds, Elma's and Betty's, seemed the only pink and white things unspotted by multitudinous photographs, Elma Leighton sought sanctuary. Pursued by a tumultuous accusing conscience, which at the same time gracefully extended the uncertain friendliness of hope, for who could say--it might still be "embarr*ass*ment," she opened her little own bright red dictionary.

9835-martin-conisby-s-vengeance.title: Martin Conisby S Vengeance
9835-martin-conisby-s-vengeance.creator: Unknown
9835-martin-conisby-s-vengeance.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Justice, O God, upon mine enemy. For the pain I suffer, may I see him suffer; for the anguish that is mine, so may I watch his agony! Thou art a just God, so, God of Justice, give to me vengeance!"

arxiv-2108-11854.title: Development of Econophysics: A Biased Account From Kolkata
arxiv-2108-11854.creator: Bikas K Chakrabarti, Antika Sinha
arxiv-2108-11854.description: Abstract We present here a somewhat personalized account of the emergence of econophysics as an attractive research topic in physical as well as social sciences. After a rather detailed story telling about our endeavors from Kolkata, we give a brief description of the main research achievements in a simple and non-technical language.

arxiv-2311-07808.description: Abstract In this paper we design a new primal-dual algorithm for the classic discrete optimization problem of maximizing a monotone submodular function subject to a cardinality constraint achieving the optimal approximation of ( 1 − 1 / e ) (1-1/e) .

arxiv-2404-16151.title: Primordial dust rings, hidden dust mass, and the first generation of planetesimals in gravitationally unstable protoplanetary disks
arxiv-2404-16151.creator: Eduard I. Vorobyov, Aleksandr M. Skliarevskii, Manuel Guedel, and Tamara Molyarova
arxiv-2404-16151.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eduard I. Vorobyov, Aleksandr M. Skliarevskii, Manuel Guedel, and Tamara Molyarova. A new mechanism of dust accumulation and planetesimal formation in a gravitationally unstable disk with suppressed magnetorotational instability is studied and compared with the classical dead zone in a layered disk model. We use numerical hydrodynamics simulations in the thin-disk limit ( FEOSAD code) to model the formation and long-term evolution of gravitationally unstable disks, including dust dynamics and growth.

arxiv-2412-12169.title: Regulation of Language Models With Interpretability Will Likely Result In A Performance Trade-Off
arxiv-2412-12169.creator: Eoin M. Kenny, Julie A. Shah
arxiv-2412-12169.description: Abstract Regulation is increasingly cited as the most important and pressing concern in machine learning. However, it is currently unknown how to implement this, and perhaps more importantly, how it would effect model performance alongside human collaboration if actually realized.

pmc-10640972.title: Case report: Episodic ataxia without ataxia?
pmc-10640972.creator: Andrea Gaudio, Fabio Gotta, Clarissa Ponti, Francesca Sanguineri, Lucia Trevisan, Alessandro Geroldi, Serena Patrone, Chiara Gemelli, Corrado Cabona, Guja Astrea, Chiara Fiorillo, Stefano Gustincich, Marina Grandis, Paola Mandich
pmc-10640972.description: Hereditary myopathies represent a clinically and genetically heterogeneous group of neuromuscular disorders, characterized by highly variable clinical presentations and frequently overlapping phenotypes with other neuromuscular disorders, likely influenced by genetic and environmental modifiers. Genetic testing is often challenging due to ambiguous clinical diagnosis.

pmc-11477559.title: Fractional-Order Modeling of Heat and Moisture Transfer in Anisotropic Materials Using a Physics-Informed Neural Network
pmc-11477559.creator: Yaroslav Sokolovskyy, Kazimierz Drozd, Tetiana Samotii, Iryna Boretska
pmc-11477559.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Mathematical models of heat and moisture transfer for anisotropic materials, based on the use of the fractional calculus of integro-differentiation, are considered because such two-factor fractal models have not been proposed in the literature so far. The numerical implementation of mathematical models for determining changes in heat exchange and moisture exchange is based on the adaptation of the fractal neural network method, grounded in the physics of processes.

pmc-11506567.title: Molecular Thumbprints: Biological Signatures That Measure Loss of Identity
pmc-11506567.creator: Pallavi R Devchand, Michael Dicay, John L Wallace, Hervé Guillou, Manuel Vázquez-Carrera
pmc-11506567.description: Each life is challenged to adapt to an ever-changing environment with integrity—simply put, to maintain identity. We hypothesize that this mission statement of adaptive homeostasis is particularly poignant in an adaptive response, like inflammation. A maladaptive response of unresolved inflammation can seed chronic disease over a lifetime.

pmc-12546704.title: Research and application on the “multi-layer” filling body with foamed expansion filling material for gob-side entry retaining gateway
pmc-12546704.creator: Leilei Zhao, Yafeng Han, Xifan Li, Shuai Wang, Gang Jing, Zaijiang Yu
pmc-12546704.description: Gob-side filling body consolidated by inorganic filling materials had gradually been widely used in gob-side entry retaining technology and engineering. However, the excessive stiffness of traditional filling body leads to severe damage of filling body and surrounding rocks under overburden pressure, especially in large mining height mining faces.

pmc-12981521.title: Wealth, health, and happiness: An inverse story of the Easterlin Paradox in China
pmc-12981521.creator: Yangjie Wang, Lianhua Li, Juan Huang, Hongjie Qiang, Shihe Fu, Chih-Wei Tseng, Chih-Wei Tseng, Chih-Wei Tseng, Chih-Wei Tseng, Chih-Wei Tseng
pmc-12981521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). One popular explanation for the Easterlin paradox is that income growth over time is usually accompanied by industrialization and pollution, which cause damage to happiness that cannot be reflected by income change. We examine this explanation by exploring the effects of a large-scale environmental regulation program -the “Two Control Zones (TCZ)” Policy- on subjective well-being (SWB) using data from a series of household surveys in China.

pmc-13144628.title: PARP inhibitors and breast cancer: from therapeutic breakthrough to resistance challenge
pmc-13144628.creator: Weiyun Wang, Chenghui Cai, Sisi Qin, Liujun He, Qinhao Liang, Siyao Tang, Jie Xie, Ting Long, Jing Hou, Wootae Kim, Fei Zhao
pmc-13144628.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Breast cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women worldwide. Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors have emerged as a critical therapeutic option, particularly for patients with triple-negative breast cancer and other HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer harboring BRCA mutations. Despite their clinical success, the emergence of primary and acquired resistance to PARP inhibitors poses a significant challenge, limiting their long-term effectiveness.

pmc-13383069.title: Optimize Before You Synthesize—Enhancing the Ionic Conductivity of Li7SiPS8 Using Bayesian Optimization
pmc-13383069.creator: Lucas G Balzat, Robert Calaminus, Yinghan Zhao, Kristina Gjorgjevikj, Igor Moudrakovski, Simon Krause, Arnd Koeppe, Britta Nestler, Bettina V Lotsch
pmc-13383069.description: Tetragonal Li7SiPS8 is a superionic solid electrolyte, yet its Li ion conductivity suffers from the presence of an amorphous side phase. Attempts to optimize the ionic conductivity, however, are incremental and hence time‐consuming, because the relationship between synthesis conditions and electrolyte performance is largely unknown.

pmc-13432547.creator: Sethmi Ranasinghe, Xenia Berger, Wandia Kimita, Kristi Biswas, Raymond Kim, Richard Douglas

pmc-13551323.title: Omitting the 5-fluorouracil bolus in metastatic colorectal cancer: impact on survival and toxicity in a retrospective multicentre cohort
pmc-13551323.creator: Ahmed Sohaib, Eman H Hebesh, Naglaa Said Elabd, Omnia Korani, Mohamed T Amin, Huda I Abd-Elhafiz, Amira M Badawy, Samar Hosny
pmc-13551323.description: IntroductionThe clinical value of the 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) bolus in modern multidrug regimens for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) is uncertain, with concerns about added haematologic toxicity. This study assessed the impact of omitting the 5-FU bolus on survival and toxicity in patients receiving mFOLFOX6-based chemotherapy.
